message: Only one principal sacred header may be selected; Ganesha and Om share the same slot.
Sacred imagery must never be cropped, obscured, placed beneath feet or controls, or used as a low-opacity texture.
Only one primary architectural structure; pillars must match its family.
Open and closed temple doors are states of one structure and cannot coexist.
Select at most three principal flower families.
Flowers must not cover critical text; foreground flowers remain below text-safe regions.
Rangoli, lamps, kalash and banana plants must remain physically grounded and correctly constructed.
Only one principal animal family; inward-facing pairs may not compete for the same corners.
Calligraphy is limited to names and short headings; body text stays readable, editable HTML.
Select at most three continuous ambient animation families.
Door, curtain and envelope opening experiences are mutually exclusive; reduced motion uses static states.
Music starts only after user interaction and must be optional.
Browsing is free; only active selections are priced, and replacement removes the prior charge.
Recommend a higher tier when it includes the same features for less than the current tier plus additions.
Required usability and accessibility features are never premium add-ons.
